reviews.review_description:
Liquid Sort VR is a fun VR game that cleverly combines two concepts into one: bartending and liquid-sorting puzzles. Your job is to serve thirsty, demanding customers, but there's a catch — all your liquids have been mixed up, and getting the right drink to the right customer is far trickier than it sounds!

You'll need to empty bottles, free up space, access the liquids you need, and carefully pour the correct amounts in the right order to complete each recipe. Planning your moves is essential because one wrong decision can leave you stuck without enough room to continue.

The difficulty ramps up progressively, with more recipes, bottles, and different liquids to manage. What starts as a fairly straightforward task quickly becomes a real test of precision, organisation, and concentration. There's a surprising amount of pressure involved when you're trying to keep everything under control while satisfying your customers!

I really enjoy how the game combines the familiar fun of bartending with the extra challenge of a sorting puzzle. It's easy to understand but increasingly tricky to master, making it a satisfying experience for anyone who enjoys problem-solving games in VR.

A fun, engaging, and surprisingly challenging title that keeps your hands and brain busy. Highly recommended!

This game is a color-sorting puzzle. It's perfect if you want a relaxing phone game that doesn't require too much brainpower. It feels exactly like a classic solitaire card game reincarnated into a VR cocktail-mixing game. The gameplay is simple and straightforward as you manage a maximum of 3 customers at the bar ordering drinks.
I highly appreciate the simplicity of the game. I like the details of the ornaments on the drinks.
Very addictive VR game that drinks inspiration from the popular mobile puzzle color water game. 
We just need names for the customers and drinks. Make fun names for the drinks 🍸 🤪. 
Maybe we could make our own mixes and name them too. It needs a leatherboard.
I encourage the developer to keep improving it and you should give it try. Nothing to loose. It's free right now.
